facebook.caption:
563 reviews. 4.0 stars. Suoi Tranh Waterfall keeps getting people back.

Most visitors pass through Phu Quoc without leaving the beach strip. This one makes you walk into the jungle, hear the water before you see it, and actually feel like you went somewhere.

Suối Tranh is on TL47 in Suối Mây. Easy to reach, easy to underestimate.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
